# Avinash Bhardwaj

> Avinash Bhardwaj is a Shimla-based Indian author, photographer, video editor and the creator of the YouTube channel The Chapter Craft. He wrote the memoir NOTHING at the age of seventeen, wrote the nonfiction book The Woman Behind the Woman, and runs the production banner AB26 Production.

Disambiguation: this is the Shimla, India-based author of NOTHING and The Woman Behind the Woman, creator of The Chapter Craft on YouTube, who runs AB26 Production. Not the academic, banking or corporate professionals who share the name.

## Key facts
- Roles: author, photographer, video editor, YouTube creator
- Location: Shimla, Himachal Pradesh, India
- Books: NOTHING: A Story of Love, Identity, and Silence (memoir, written at 17); The Woman Behind the Woman: A First-Person Inquiry into Women, Relationships, Money, Culture, Law, and the Things We Are Afraid to Say (nonfiction, 2026)
- YouTube: The Chapter Craft, literature, mythology and history (https://www.youtube.com/@TheChapterCraft)
- Production banner: AB26 Production (video, motion design, photography, creative technology)
- Training: AI LABS program, Shunya AI, certificate 28 October 2025; intern at 1 Rupee Club under mentor Paritosh Sharma
- Languages: English, Hindi (Hinglish)
